title: iHelp resource index
description: Shape of lib/library/resource-index.json, generated by `bun run library:index` (scripts/library-index.ts). Three normalized maps — courses, docs, assets — whose records point at each other by id. Every property below says where its value comes from, so a person or an agent can use the index without reading the sources. Never import the index from app code; query it with `bun run library:find` or jq.

$schema.description: Relative path to this schema, so editors that honour a document's `$schema` validate and autocomplete the index. Constant.

version.description: Shape version of the index. Bumped only when a field is removed or changes meaning; adding a field does not bump it.

about.description: One paragraph saying how the file is generated, which sources it is built from, that it must not be edited by hand or imported from app code, and how to query it. Constant text from scripts/library-shared.ts.

totals.description: Headline counts, all derived from the three maps below. A quick way to see whether a rebuild changed the shape of the library.

courses.description: Number of courses in lib/courses/catalog.ts COURSES — the number of keys in `courses`.

coursesWithLibrary.description: Courses that have at least one library card, curated or generated (`counts.assets > 0`). Courses without one, like SPORT, are excluded.

docs.description: Number of entries in `docs`: every Markdown file under content/courses, data/it-kmitl and data/en-kmitl, plus any virtual doc.

renderedDocs.description: How many of those docs are bound to at least one module (`rendered: true`), i.e. reachable on the site.

assets.description: Number of entries in `assets`: every card lib/library/subject-library.ts mergedAssets() returns for any course, past exams included.

curated.description: Cards with origin `curated` — hand-written in the per-course arrays of lib/library/subject-library.ts.

generated.description: Cards with origin `generated` — derived from a file name by scripts/build-library-manifest.mjs (lib/library/library-manifest.json).

insider.description: Cards with access `insider`, i.e. isRestrictedAsset() is true (past exams).

files.description: Distinct values of an asset's `path`: the number of files behind the cards. Two cards on different pages of one PDF count once; cards that are site pages (path null) count zero.

sizeBytes.description: Summed `sizeBytes` over those distinct files, from lib/library/library-stats.json. A file with no stats entry counts as 0.

pages.description: Summed PDF `pages` over those distinct files, from lib/library/library-stats.json. Images and unreadable PDFs count 0.

courses.description: One entry per catalogued course, keyed by its catalog code, in lib/courses/catalog.ts COURSES order.

docs.description: One entry per Markdown document, keyed by doc id (the repo-relative path, or `virtual:…` for bound content with no file), sorted by key.

assets.description: One entry per library card, keyed by asset id. Insertion order is course order (COURSES), then lib/library/subject-library.ts mergedAssets() order within a course: curated cards first, then generated ones.

text.description: A bilingual string, as the app's LText: Thai and English.

en.description: English text. Where the source has none (LText.en is optional, for content ported from Thai-only sources) it repeats the Thai, which is what the app shows an English reader (lib/ltext.ts t()).

scopeOrNull.description: Which exam the material is studied for: `midterm` or `final`; null for anything spanning the whole term. The boundary is whatever each course's own summary.md says, never a guess from a file name.

course.description: One course: its identity from the catalog, the 11 spine modules joined with what it binds, its week rows and the ids of its docs and cards.

code.description: Short course code from lib/courses/catalog.ts (ITF, ICS, MFIT…). Equal to the key in `courses`; the asset folder name is this, lowercased.

officialCode.description: Official KMITL subject code (catalog `officialCode`, e.g. 06016402). Null for a course that has none (CHEM).

dir.description: Directory name from catalog courseDir(): `<officialCode>-<slug>`, or just the slug without an official code. It names the content folder and the URL.

name.description: Course name, Thai and English, from the catalog's `nameTh` and `nameEn`.

group.description: Catalog group the course is listed under: Y1-S1, Y1-S2 or EN-KMITL.

credits.description: Credits string from the catalog, such as "3 (2-2-5)". Null when the catalog gives none.

contentDir.description: Repo-relative folder holding the course's Markdown (summary.md, blueprint.md, archive/…): content/courses/<dir>.

assetDirs.description: Distinct public/assets/<namespace>/<subject> folders that the paths of the course's cards live in, sorted. The tree is gitignored locally; the same keys are mirrored in the Supabase buckets.

modules.description: The 11 standard modules in spine order (lib/courses/spine.ts STANDARD_SPINE), each joined with what the course binds in lib/courses/course-bindings.ts, as lib/courses/course-spine.ts resolveCourseSpine() resolves it.

id.description: Module id from STANDARD_SPINE: orientation, syllabus_map, deep_summary, cram_sheet, key_cards, drill, speed_quiz, applied, mock_exam, weak_spot or archive.

segment.description: The module's URL segment under /courses/<dir>/ (STANDARD_SPINE `segment`). Deliberately not the id: segments are shared links and never move.

status.description: available = bound and filled (a doc loads, a bank has questions, or it carries an href); coming_soon = on the spine with nothing bound; locked = withheld on purpose. resolveCourseSpine() returns only the first two today.

href.description: Where the module renders: the binding's own `href` when it has one (PSCP's problem bank lives at /pscp), else /courses/<dir>/<segment>. Null unless the module is available.

docs.description: Ids (keys of `docs`) of the Markdown documents bound to this module, in the binding's order. A doc bound to several modules appears under each.

readiness.description: The Readiness Index of scripts/readiness.ts: how much of the spine the course fills.

available.description: Number of modules whose status is `available`.

total.description: Number of modules on the spine — 11.

weeks.description: Week rows. For a course with a schedule in lib/library/course-weeks.ts (ITF and ICS) these are exactly the rows of the library's week view, in its order. For every other course there is one row per distinct week number found on its cards and docs, sorted, with no title or scope.

week.description: Week number. ITF runs 0–15 (0 is orientation); ICS numbers both halves 1–7, which `scope` tells apart.

scope.description: Half of the term the row belongs to, from course-weeks.ts. Null for a row without one (ITF week 0) and for every row of a course with no schedule.

title.description: Row heading from course-weeks.ts, Thai and English. Null when the course has no schedule.

upcoming.description: True when course-weeks.ts marks the week as not yet released on OnLearn, so its files are earlier editions. Always false without a schedule.

video.description: Link to the week's lecture recording on OnLearn from course-weeks.ts. Null when there is none; it stays behind the same sign-in as the slides.

docs.description: Ids of the course's own docs filed under the week: the doc's `week` against the row, matched like cards (first matching row, scope taken from the doc's binding).

assets.description: Ids of the cards filed under the week, by the rule of the library week view (components/subject-library/weekly-table.tsx weekOf): the card's week (`asset.week ?? asset.chapter`) equals the row's week and the scopes are compatible, first matching row wins.

unscheduledAssets.description: Ids of cards that land in no week row: they name no week or chapter, or (for a scheduled course) name one the schedule does not list. The library week view shows these under the whole-term heading.

assets.description: Ids of every card of the course in lib/library/subject-library.ts mergedAssets() order: curated entries, then generated ones whose url no curated entry claims.

docs.description: Ids of the docs the course owns, sorted: those under content/courses/<dir>/ and data/<namespace>/<subject>/. A doc another course binds is still listed only under its owner here.

counts.description: Tallies over the course's cards, so a summary needs no loop.

assets.description: All cards of the course — the length of `assets`.

generated.description: Cards with origin `generated`: files nobody has written a curated entry for.

insider.description: Cards with access `insider` (past exams), served only to insiders.

legacy.description: Cards whose status is `legacy`: earlier-year editions kept next to the current one.

withScope.description: Cards that carry a midterm/final scope.

withWeek.description: Cards that name a week or chapter.

byCategory.description: Card count per `category` (lecture, cheatsheet, exam, exercise, note, reference), keys sorted. Cards with no category are counted under `uncategorised`.

doc.description: One Markdown document: where it lives, which course owns it, which modules render it and which library cards its file tables point at.

id.description: Doc id, equal to its key in `docs`: the repo-relative path, or `virtual:<CODE>/<segment>/<slug>` for bound content that matches no file.

path.description: Repo-relative path of the Markdown file, with forward slashes. Null for a virtual doc.

course.description: Code of the course that owns the doc, taken from its folder (content/courses/<dir>/ or data/<namespace>/<subject>/) or from the loader that reads it (data/en-kmitl/*.md belongs to COMPRO). A virtual doc takes the one course that binds it. Null when shared or unowned, e.g. content/courses/README.md.

role.description: What kind of document it is, from its name and place: overview = summary.md; blueprint = blueprint.md (notes for content builders, never rendered by design); week = archive/weekNN.md; study-guide = a file whose name contains `study-guide`; data = under data/ (readers' source notes); readme = README.md in any case; virtual = bound content that matches no file; doc = anything else.

title.description: Text of the document's first `# ` heading, with front matter and fenced code skipped. Null when it has none.

rendered.description: True when at least one module binding in lib/courses/course-bindings.ts renders the doc. A doc nothing renders is dead weight unless it is a blueprint or a README.

bindings.description: Every module binding that renders the doc, in course then spine order. A doc is matched to a binding by exact content equality with what the binding's `load()` returns; identical files all bind.

module.description: Id of the spine module that renders the doc.

slug.description: The binding's ModuleDoc `slug`: stable within the module and the value of the `?doc=` query that opens it.

href.description: Where a reader opens the doc: `<module href>?doc=<slug>` when the module holds several docs (components/module-reader.tsx), else the module's href. Null when the module has no href.

chapter.description: The binding's `chapter`: which week or chapter the doc covers. Null when the binding does not say.

scope.description: The binding's `scope` for this doc. Null when the doc spans the term.

week.description: The week the doc covers: the first binding's `chapter`, else NN from a file named weekNN.md, else null.

updated.description: The `updated:` value in the doc's front matter, without quotes. Null when the doc has none.

assetRefs.description: Ids of the cards the doc's file tables resolve to, in document order. Resolved with the rules of parseSessionDocTable() in components/md-view.tsx against the cards the doc's page receives: the course's library minus past exams.

unresolvedRefs.description: Raw text of file cells that match no card (document order, de-duplicated). On a rendered doc each one is a dead card — listed, but with nothing to preview or download. Fix the file name in the doc or the card's fileName.

asset.description: One library card, as the app's SubjectAsset, with where its file lives, who may read it and which docs use it.

id.description: Card id, equal to its key in `assets`: SubjectAsset.id (generated cards are `gen-<subject>-<folder>-<name>-<ext>`). Ids should be unique; when a source id repeats, the later card is keyed `<id>~2`, `<id>~3`… and `bun run library:audit` reports the collision.

course.description: Code of the course whose library the card is in (a key of `courses`).

origin.description: curated = written by hand in lib/library/subject-library.ts, with bilingual title, scope and week; generated = derived from a file name by scripts/build-library-manifest.mjs for a file with no curated entry.

title.description: Card title, Thai and English. For a generated card both are the same, derived from the file name.

description.description: Card description, Thai and English, from SubjectAsset.description. Null when both are empty, as on every generated card.

category.description: Gallery shelf, exactly as SubjectAsset.category is set — never inferred here. lecture = slide decks; cheatsheet = condensed summaries; exam = past papers and quizzes (insider-only); exercise = worksheets, labs, practice; note = scanned notes; reference = lookup material. Generated cards take it from their folder.

fileType.description: How the preview renders the card (SubjectAsset.fileType): pdf, image, md (a page on this site) or file (download only).

url.description: The card's url exactly as authored. A file is /assets/<namespace>/<subject>/<folder>/<name> and may end in a fragment such as #page=3 that opens a PDF at a page; a md card points at a site route.

path.description: Repo-relative path of the file: `public` plus the url without its fragment, when the url starts with /assets/. Null for a card that is a site page. The tree under public/assets is gitignored.

fileName.description: SubjectAsset.fileName: the name offered for download, and the name docs refer to in their file tables. Expected to equal the last segment of `path`; the audit flags a mismatch.

anyOf.description: Where the file's object lives in Supabase Storage.

bucket.description: ihelp-library (public) for member cards; ihelp-library-exams (private, served by signed URL to insiders) when access is insider.

key.description: Object key from lib/library/storage-key.ts storageKey(): the path without /assets/, with non-ASCII segments transliterated. The same key is used in both buckets.

storage.description: The Storage bucket and object key the file is uploaded to by `bun run assets:sync`. Null when `path` is null.

access.description: Who may read it. insider = isRestrictedAsset() in lib/library/subject-library-ui.ts: category `exam`, or a path containing /exams/. member = every other card — its file is in the public bucket even though the library list needs an IT KMITL login.

week.description: The week or chapter the card is filed under: SubjectAsset.week, else SubjectAsset.chapter, else null. This is the number the library week view matches against a schedule row.

scope.description: SubjectAsset.scope. Set by hand from the course's own summary.md; generated cards never carry one.

edition.description: SubjectAsset.edition: the academic year or cohort tag such as "2569" or "Y1/S1". Null when untagged.

status.description: SubjectAsset.status, as set. Cards marked `legacy` or `duplicate` are folded away in the week view.

isCurrentYear.description: SubjectAsset.isCurrentYear: true for the official current academic year's copy. False when unset.

duplicateOf.description: SubjectAsset.duplicateOf as authored: the id or the file name of the canonical card this one duplicates. Null when it duplicates nothing.

sourceUrl.description: SubjectAsset.sourceUrl: the OnLearn page the file was originally posted on (ต้นทาง). Null when it did not come from the course site.

groupId.description: SubjectAsset.groupId: the scan set (key of ASSET_GROUPS in lib/library/subject-library-ui.ts) the card collapses into in the gallery. Null when ungrouped.

tags.description: SubjectAsset.tags: display tags such as "Week 13" or "Cheatsheet", in a mix of Thai and English. Searched by `bun run library:find`.

sizeBytes.description: File size in bytes from lib/library/library-stats.json, keyed by the url without its fragment. Null when stats have no entry.

pages.description: PDF page count from lib/library/library-stats.json, keyed like sizeBytes. Null for images and anything stats could not count.

onDisk.description: True when `path` is in lib/library/library-manifest.json, the snapshot of public/assets at the last `bun run library:manifest`. False when it is not, and also when `path` is null (no file). Read from the manifest, never from the disk, so the index is identical wherever it is built.

usedBy.description: Sorted ids (keys of `docs`) of the docs whose `assetRefs` include this card, i.e. the pages whose file tables show it.
